front: State the quantity theory of money.
back: MV = PT: money supply × velocity = price level × volume of transactions.

front: Monetarist view of long-run aggregate supply?
back: Vertical at the full employment level of output.

front: Name one strength and one weakness of the monetarist view.
back: Strength: explains inflation from excess money growth. Weakness: velocity is often unstable and the money supply is hard to control.
